root_question: Can origin/main be promoted to the production actor, manifest, and private stage through one exact public payload with verified rollback and zero downstream activity?
facts: origin/main is exact, clean, contains the approved single-source adapter, and is a fast-forward descendant of the runtime actor
the runtime actor is clean and inert but lacks the single-source adapter
queue is empty, state contains only the current activation barrier, and no runtime process has a PID
host free space exceeds the required reserve and swap did not increase across the two samples
the actor recovery CLI has an internal failure rollback but deletes its actor backup after success
production manifest and private stage updates are separate public boundaries without aggregate post-success rollback
blocker: No public CLI atomically promotes actor, production manifest, and private stage while retaining a verified post-success rollback boundary.
frontier: Add or formally approve one aggregate promotion entrypoint that keeps the prior actor and manifest until stage and activation-only postchecks pass, and restores all correlated state on any failure.
remaining_risk: executing the existing actor restore first can leave the actor at the new SHA while the production manifest remains pinned to the old SHA
a later manifest or stage failure has no public path to restore the deleted actor backup under the origin/main-only authority rule
high absolute host swap remains an operational concern even though the sampled delta was negative and runtime RSS was zero
